chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Amr ibn Uthman al-Kazzaz from Sabbah al-Hadda' from Isma'il ibn 'Ammar from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked: What do you say about a person in ihram who played with his penis and thereby ejaculated? He said: I see upon him the same as what is upon the one who had intercourse with his wife while in ihram: a camel and the hajj next year. This does not contradict the first two reports because it is not impossible that the ruling for the one who played with his penis is stricter than the ruling for the one who had intercourse in what is below the genital organ, because he committed a prohibition that is not permissible in any way, whereas the one who had intercourse did not commit a prohibition except in that he did it at a time when permission for that was not legislated for him. And it is possible that this report is to be understood as indicating a degree of emphasis and strictness of preference, rather than it being obligatory.

key_terms.بَدَنَةً: A camel (a type of sacrificial animal penalty)
key_terms.فِيمَا دُونَ الْفَرْجِ: In what is below the genital organ (referring to non-penetrative sexual act)
key_terms.مُحْرِمٍ: One in the state of ihram (ritual consecration for hajj or umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for a pilgrim who masturbates while in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) rules that a person in ihram who masturbates and ejaculates must pay the same penalty as one who has sexual intercourse: a camel and performing hajj the following year. This ruling is stricter than intercourse because masturbation is inherently forbidden, whereas intercourse is only forbidden due to the timing during ihram.
